newsitem.title: THAILAND: Foreign deals on Thai bourse only in dlrs - SEC.
newsitem.headline: Foreign deals on Thai bourse only in dlrs - SEC.

text.p: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commisssion said on Tuesday that the central bank would require foreigners dealing in Thai stocks to settle in US dollars only.
But it said the measure was only temporary.

The move will be temporary and is aimed at curbing baht supplies to foreign currency speculators who attacked the baht last month and are now desperate to acquire the currency to cover short positions, said Prasarn Trairatworakul, SEC deputy secretary general said.
"The measures will apply to foreign board only," Prasarn told Reuters.
"Under this measure, custodians will be asked to settle the deals for foreign stock investors in U.S. dollars only...no actual baht will change hands," he said.
Prasarn said there had been some irregularities which indicated that some foreign investors were using the stock market to acquire the baht, presumably to cover foreign exchange positions.
